_about: Feanie, Valentine (221078, sleep_puppy_vt23): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names: Feanie, Pur Lilie (she calls her Lilie), Mary and Wilfred (Wil), Albert, Light, Stella, Alk, Valentine's Fest. Her lines keep global Feanie's sleepy, childlike voice.
profile: A sleep-inducing princess who wants to be helpful to all sorts of people. At Valentine's Fest, she's studying love as hard as she can. In a brand-new outfit, she uses her dream-showing powers to guide lost lambs troubled by love into dreams yet again today.
titleCondition: Level Feanie to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/fininokoiwa: I wonder what shape my love will be...? I hope it's soft and fluffy and warm~ like a nap...
speech.home/happibarento_arigatoto: Happy Valentine~ Here's a present to say thank you and good job always working so hard~♪ ...Huh? What's wrong? Why are you crying~? M-Mister Albert~?
speech.home/koino: Leave helping with love to me too~♪ Bask in the warm, sunny light~ meet the one you love in a dream~ and tell them you love them~
speech.home/koiwa: Love is~... thump-thumpy... and floaty~... and nervous and jittery~...? Mmm~. My head's getting all sleepy~...
speech.home/neenee_oyofuku: Hey, hey, does my outfit look good on me~? Am I all fluffy and sparkly too? ...Ehehe~, really~? Yay~♪
speech.home/warewa: I am~ the sleeping princess of dreams and love, Feanie~! Ehehe~. Denah came up with the catchphrase and pose for me~ Wanna do it with me too, Beaucy?
speech.ally/join: Ehehe~, Happy Valentine~♪ I'm gonna work super hard at helping with love too~!
speech.ally/evolution: Look, look~. I made this myself~. I put lots and lots of love and thank-yous into it~. I'd be happy if you took it~♪

storyNames.mob_date_enter_woman: Woman with a Date Coming Up

1.title: Love Like a Dream
1.summary: While strolling and enjoying the town's atmosphere, Feanie changes into a lovely outfit at Lilie's suggestion and helps hand out sweets. After hearing from women who want to rehearse confessions and dates in their dreams, Feanie asks Light about love.

lines.5: Mmm~, what a sweet smell~♪ During Valentine's Fest, it's like the whole town turned into candy~
lines.10: S-Stella~. Those people are hugging and kissing~. Hawawa~...!
lines.13: I believe they are in love.
lines.16: I hear that when you fall in love, you want to do things like that. Perhaps the two of them have become lovers.
lines.24: Happy Valentine! The Guild is giving out sweets★ Here, you two have some too~!
lines.28: Wow~... They're all so cute~. So sparkly and fluffy~.
lines.32: Feanie, Feanie. Would you like to become all sparkly and fluffy too?
lines.40: Happy Valentine~. Let's make it a wonderful Valentine's Fest~.
lines.48: Yes! Thank you for helping★ I'm so glad the outfit fits perfectly!
lines.52: Ehehe~ thank you~. I'm happy I get to wear cute clothes too~.
lines.57: ...C-Cu, fluff... It is cute... Very, extremely, exceedingly...!
lines.66: Valentine's Fest is so fun~. I'm being helpful too~♪
lines.69: U-Um, you're Feanie, right? --Please! Make my love come true!!
lines.75: Feanie, you have the power to let people meet who they want to see in their dreams, right...?
lines.77: So, um... I was wondering if I could... rehearse my confession!
lines.79: Th-Then me too! I want to rehearse for an important date!
lines.81: Whenever I see him, my heart pounds and I can't talk properly, so...!
lines.88: Alriiight~. Leave it to me~. I'll be super helpful~♪
lines.93: Th-Thank you, Feanie! In my dream, I managed to confess properly...! I'll do my best for the real thing too!
lines.96: I'm glad I could help~. Thanks for helping out too, Light~.
lines.100: Y-Yes. But wouldn't it have been fine without me...?
lines.104: That's not true~. When you're with me, Light, I sleep even mooore soundly~.
lines.107: Love sure is mysterious~. You like someone, but you're worried~...? So you want to practice~...?
lines.110: I wonder if someday I'll fall in love with someone too~...?
lines.113: U-Um... I heard you show dreams where people can practice love... Is it already over?
lines.116: Nope~. If you want, I'll do round two too~.
lines.123: Wh-What is this mountain of paper...!?
lines.127: This is my ultimate ideal boyfriend. From his looks and personality to his catchphrases, gestures, and tastes, I "designed" everything myself...!
lines.133: Heh heh heh... Perfection doesn't exist in reality. So I'll just make a perfect boyfriend myself...!!
lines.135: I want to go on a date with a hot adventurer! A hot foreign prince is fine too! Anyone, as long as he's hot--!
lines.137: Heh heh heh... He's out of my reach... So at least in my dreams, I want him all to myself...♥ Lock him up, dote on him, and then--!!
lines.140: E-Everything has to be ideal~? Anyone's fine as long as he's hot~...? You love someone, so you lock them up~...??
lines.144: Hw-Hwaaaa~~~. My head's getting all sleepy~ maybe~??
lines.149: Stop! Stooooop!! Don't let this girl hear any mooore!!
lines.164: Th-Those were very special cases, all right? Don't use them as examples!?
lines.172: Love sure is hard~... Maybe I just don't get it--
lines.178: ...I wonder if Papa and Mama... fell in love too~...?
lines.181: Hey, hey, Light, Stella. Have you two ever been in love~?
lines.184: I wanna know more about love. Then I'll be able to be even mooore helpful, right~?
lines.188: B-But you see. Even if you ask me about love, in my case... No, never mind. There's nothing to talk about--
lines.193: Light, I would like to hear it. Please.
lines.203: Pleeease, Light~. Teach me about love~♪

2.title: The Shapes of Love
2.summary: While continuing her dream rehearsal sessions, Feanie fails to give good advice to a boy too nervous to confess even in his dream, so she starts studying love. After listening to Mary, who knows what love is, Feanie understands love just a little--and when she meets the boy again, she manages to give him good advice.

lines.5: Good work, everyone~. Have a nice Valentine's Fest~♪
lines.9: What's wrong~...? You couldn't meet the person you wanted to see...?
lines.12: N-No, I did meet her, but... I got nervous even in the dream. I couldn't confess...!
lines.14: Wh-Why can't I confess? Does that mean I'm not seriously in love with her!?
lines.17: Huh...? U-Ummm? I don't think that's~... um~...?
lines.21: I don't think so~... but~... Love is... liking someone is~... um~... hmmmm...???
lines.24: S-Sorry! It's something I need to sort out myself, right!? Excuse me...!!
lines.32: Mm~... I really need to study love harder~...!
lines.38: "Grab Hold of His Heart! Winning Tactics for the Games of Love"-- Hmm hmm~...?
lines.41: "Sometimes it's better not to say 'I love you'"? Why~? Don't you want to tell them you love them~...?
lines.45: "Confess while diving off a cliff into the sea, and success is guaranteed"... is what this book says.
lines.50: Eeeh~, that's dangerous~! It'd be awful if you drowned~.
lines.54: Hwaaa~. My head's getting all sleepy again... What is love~...?
lines.56: Hmmm~... I wonder if there's someone who knows--
lines.76: You want to understand love so you can help everyone, huh...
lines.87: N-Now that you mention it...? When I actually try to put it into words... Hmm...?
lines.90: Wanting to make someone special. ...I guess?
lines.98: The time I've spent with Wil so far, and the time we'll spend together from now on-- I wanted to make it the most special in the whole world.
lines.102: Waaah~... You really, truly love Wilfred, huh~.
lines.105: I see, I see~... Wanting to make someone special is love--
lines.108: ...Huh...? But... Mary, and Stella, and everyone are aaall special to me, and I love them, you know?
lines.111: Am I in love with everyone? But I don't feel all thump-thumpy~ or fuzzy and mixed up~...?
lines.115: Hmmmm~...? Maybe I just can't be helpful with love after all~...?
lines.126: I don't think anyone can understand everything. Don't you ever get to where you can't even understand your own feelings?
lines.130: Ah... Yeah~. I did...! It was super weird and fuzzy~.
lines.134: So, you know. I don't think you have to force yourself to understand, or try to respond to how someone feels one hundred percent.
lines.137: Or rather, you're almost too kind, Feanie! It's okay to say "This is a pain," you know?
lines.141: Hweee~? I-I don't think I can do that~?
lines.143: It's hard, and it makes me all sleepy~. But...
lines.146: ...I want to understand. The shapes of love, and how everyone feels.
lines.151: Liking someone is free, and varied, and... all wobbly...
lines.161: Because they're different... because there are so many shapes... Is that why it's hard to understand~...?
lines.170: ...I think I kinda get it now~...! Ehehe, yaaay~♪
lines.175: ...Heh. You two really are wonderful. You and Stella both.
lines.178: I'm still learning about love too, I'm sure. ...It'd be nice if we could figure it out at our own pace without rushing, right?
lines.187: Hiii~. How did your confession go~...?
lines.190: W-Well, I still haven't... Ugh, I'm so pathetic.
lines.193: You know~. How do you feel when you think about her...?
lines.196: H-How!? Well, obviously...! Just thinking about her makes my head explode and I don't know what to say--
lines.198: My "I like you"s get into a total traffic jam inside meee~!!
lines.201: I see~... So that's what your love is like~.
lines.205: Then let's practice one more time~?
lines.208: It's okay, no need to rush~. Let's do our best at our own pace~♪

3.title: The Love Story I Most Want to Hear
3.summary: While handing out Brezen, a sweet from her homeland her father taught her to make, to the people she loves, Feanie is finally reunited with her missing father. Hearing from him the story of his love with her mother, she understands love a little more, then goes to help a girl troubled by love.

lines.5: Here you go~, dig in~. I made them myself~.
lines.9: Mm...! They're delicious, Feanie. So this is a sweet from your homeland.
lines.14: They're called "Brezen"~. Papa taught me how to make them a long time ago.
lines.17: At Valentine's Fest, you can give sweets to people you love even if it's not romantic~? I didn't know that~.
lines.20: So I wanna make lots and lots and give them as presents~. I have so many people I love now~.
lines.25: I see... Everyone will be happy. If you're making more, can I help?
lines.37: Happy Valentine~. Please accept my love and thank-yous~♪
lines.40: Happy Valentine, Feanie. Guys can give gifts too, right?
lines.43: Waaah~... Thank you~! I got everyone's love~.
lines.46: This kinda gets me emotional... You know, like how a dad feels getting a present from his daughter? Maybe it's like this--
lines.48: S-Someday you'll definitely be able to give one to your dad too, Feanie! He's bound to be even happier than us...!
lines.51: It's okay~. I believe that too~.
lines.54: I hope Papa will be happy~. I hope I can see him soon~.
lines.57: ...Come to think of it, I heard that traveler over there is looking for family he got separated from too. There sure are a lot of folks like that...
lines.60: ...Happy Valentine. I hope you get to meet the one you love~...
lines.69: It's Papa, Papa! Do you recognize me? I-I've been looking all this time--!!
lines.79: Papa~. Stop crying already~. Your eyes are all red~?
lines.81: Ugh... Sorry, Fee... It still feels like a dream... Uuuugh~...!
lines.87: ...I'm really sorry, Fee. We still haven't found Mama, and I left you all alone...
lines.89: I'm sure I made you go through so much pain--
lines.92: Nuh-uh~. It wasn't only painful, you know?
lines.95: I got to meet wonderful people~. There were times I didn't understand my own feelings and everything felt fuzzy, but...
lines.98: Everyone taught me. And then my love and thank-yous grew and grew...
lines.101: So, you know? I know what I want to tell you.
lines.105: --I always, always wanted to see you. You and Mama both. You're both always special, and I love you so much~...!
lines.108: ...Fee... You've really grown into a wonderful girl...!
lines.111: Uh-huh~! I'm being helpful with my dream-showing powers too~.
lines.116: And lately~, I've been studying love too~.
lines.122: Love comes in all kinds of shapes, huh? I was so surprised~.
lines.125: L-L-L-L-Love!? D-D-Don't tell me you have a boyfriend, Fee!?
lines.128: Nuh-uh~. I still don't know what shape my love is.
lines.132: ...Hey, hey, Papa. What was your love with Mama like?
lines.135: Wh-What's this all of a sudden!? I don't remember stories from that long ago...!
lines.139: Liar~. You told me about your anniversaries with Mama~ and the day I was born~ dozens of times~.
lines.142: I wanna know more~. About you and Mama~.
lines.145: ...Yeah... You're right. Then I'll tell you all about it, starting from the day I first met your mother!
lines.153: I'm so glad you got to see your father again...! I couldn't be happier★
lines.157: Thank you, Lilie~! From now on, I'm gonna look for Mama together with Papa~.
lines.160: I'll still be relying on you all a lot~... Is that okay?
lines.168: Thank you, Light~. Thank you, everyone~! Let's keep getting along~!
lines.171: If I confess, he might turn me down... Then maybe I should just keep things the way they are... No, but-- Ugh~, what do I do...!
lines.174: Love troubles~? If you want, I'll listen~?
lines.177: Dreams and love, I can help with both~. Leave it to me~♪

1221078/1.19:
A sleep-inducing princess who wants to be helpful to all sorts of people. At Valentine's Fest, she's studying love as hard as she can.

In a brand-new outfit, she uses her dream-showing powers to guide lost lambs troubled by love into dreams yet again today.

5000620/1.19:
Rehearsals for love confessions and dates that make use of Feanie's ability to "let people meet who they want to see in their dreams."

It was a hit with some at Valentine's Fest, but Light, wary of the clients' requests escalating more and more, now apparently refuses them flat out.

5000621/1.19:
A traditional sweet handed down for generations in Feanie's homeland. A simple treat made by tying long, thin dough into a knot and baking it firm.

The Brezen she handed out as a token of friendship were generally well received by Palpebra's adventurers, and some members of the Fang mercenary band even started crying as they remembered their faraway homeland.
